statements.impact_statement: The affected Docker daemon AuthZ request-body path is not part of the Alloy client runtime. HAProxy accepts only allowlisted GET/HEAD requests and does not delegate authorization decisions to a Docker AuthZ plugin.
statements.action_statement: Re-evaluate when the Alloy image, embedded Docker module, or HAProxy allowlist changes.

statements.impact_statement: The affected Docker daemon PUT archive handler is not part of the Alloy client runtime. HAProxy denies PUT and does not allow any containers archive path.
statements.action_statement: Re-evaluate when the Alloy image, embedded Docker module, or HAProxy allowlist changes.

statements.impact_statement: The affected Docker daemon archive mount setup is not part of the Alloy client runtime. HAProxy denies PUT and HEAD requests to every containers archive path.
statements.action_statement: Re-evaluate when the Alloy image, embedded Docker module, or HAProxy allowlist changes.
